北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气较浓，出门注意能见度，戴好口罩哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy. Be mindful of visibility and wear a mask!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，记得添衣保暖，别着凉了！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool. Remember to add clothes to stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗舒适，体感 16℃，风力稍大，注意防风哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, feels like 16℃. It's a bit windy, mind the wind!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾大湿度高，体感温暖。出门注意交通安全！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is very foggy and humid, feels warm. Please be safe when traveling!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 24℃，暖和湿润。带把伞，有备无患哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels like 24℃, warm and humid. Carry an umbrella, just in case.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阳光正好，体感 19℃，风儿轻柔。适合户外活动！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has perfect sunshine, feels like 19℃, gentle breeze. Great for outdoors!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴空万里，体感 16℃。昼夜温差大，早晚注意添衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear and sunny, feels like 16℃. Big temperature difference, add layers in morning/evening.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 19℃，湿度高。记得带伞，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 19℃, high humidity. Remember your umbrella, and stay cheerful.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天微暖，体感 19℃。湿度较高，出门带把伞哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and slightly warm, feels like 19℃. High humidity, remember your umbrella!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感舒适。昼夜温差大，早晚注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is partly cloudy, feels comfortable. Big temperature difference, stay warm morning/evening.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 18℃，湿度大。出门带伞，注意防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 18℃, high humidity. Carry an umbrella, mind the dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗风大，体感 11℃。风力 5级，注意防风保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and windy, feels like 11℃. Strong winds, stay warm and guard against wind!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有小雨，体感 11℃，有些凉。出门记得带雨具哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has light rain, feels like 11℃, a bit chilly. Remember your umbrella!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 15℃。湿度高，出门记得带把伞！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 15℃. High humidity, remember your umbrella!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 20℃，较为舒适。注意防晒，保持愉快！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 20℃, quite comfortable. Mind the sun and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 10℃，风力 5级。风大体感凉，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny, feels like 10℃, with strong winds. It's chilly due to wind, stay warm and guard against wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感只有 8℃，风力 5级。风寒，务必添衣保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like only 8℃, with strong winds. It's cold with wind, definitely add layers to stay warm!
